DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-02-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-02-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 稲刈りの見学をご希望でしたね。今日は、まだ刈り始めていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-02-001-SHARED.translation: You wanted to watch the rice harvest, right? We haven't started cutting today.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-02-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-02-001-SHARED.sourceJa: そうでしたか。今日見られると思って来ました。待っていれば午後に始まる予定でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-02-001-SHARED.hintJa: 当日稲刈りを見られると思ったと話し午後開始予定を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-02-001-SHARED.translation: I see. I came thinking I could watch today. If I wait, is it scheduled to start this afternoon?
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-02-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you expected to watch harvesting today and ask whether it will start in the afternoon.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-02-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-02-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 今日は行いません。見学の日は、田んぼの様子を見てからお知らせします。今の稲なら、見学路からご覧になれます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-02-001-SHARED.translation: We won't harvest today. We'll announce a viewing date after checking the paddy. You can see the rice as it is now from the viewing path.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-02-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-02-001-SHARED.sourceJa: それなら今の様子を見たいです。刈った後の見本もあれば、二つを比べられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-02-001-SHARED.hintJa: 当日作業なしを受け立稲と収穫後の見本を比較したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-02-001-SHARED.translation: Then I'd like to see it now. If you have a sample from after harvesting, could I compare the two?
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-02-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: After hearing there is no work today, ask in Japanese to compare standing rice with a harvested sample.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-02-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-02-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 説明台に前の収穫から残した見本があります。こちらへお持ちします。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-02-001-SHARED.translation: There's a sample saved from a previous harvest on the explanation table. I'll bring it here.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-02-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-02-001-SHARED.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。見本は手元で、田んぼの稲は道から見ます。穂の形を絵にして残したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-02-001-SHARED.hintJa: 見本と見学路からの稲を観察し穂の形を描きたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-02-001-SHARED.translation: Thank you. I'll look at the sample up close and the paddy rice from the path. I'd like to draw the shape of the ears to keep.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-02-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you'll observe the sample and rice from the viewing path and draw the ears' shapes.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-02-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-02-001-SHARED.sourceJa: この台でノートを使えます。今回の見学日のお知らせも、ご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-02-001-SHARED.translation: You can use your notebook at this table. Would you like notification of this harvest's viewing day too?

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-02-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-02-001-SHARED.sourceJa: お願いします。働く予定を合わせたいので、日が決まった後に連絡をもらえる方法を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-02-001-SHARED.hintJa: 勤務予定調整のため見学日確定後の連絡方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-02-001-SHARED.translation: Yes, please. I'd like to arrange my work schedule, so please tell me how to receive a message after the date is decided.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-02-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese how to receive notification once the viewing date is fixed, so you can adjust your work schedule.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-02-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-02-001-SHARED.sourceJa: こちらの連絡受付でお名前とご希望を承ります。今日の時点では、見学日を確定できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-02-001-SHARED.translation: We can take your name and request at this notification desk. We can't confirm the viewing day as of today.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-02-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-02-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 連絡受付へ申し込みます。今日は刈る前の稲と見本を見られたので、その絵に今日の日付を書いて持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-02-001-SHARED.hintJa: 連絡受付に申込み今日の比較観察の絵に日付を記して持帰る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-02-001-SHARED.translation: I'll register at the notification desk. Since I saw the rice before cutting and the sample today, I'll date my comparison drawing and take it home.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-02-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Register for notifications in Japanese and say you'll date and take home today's comparison drawing.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-02-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-02-001-SHARED.sourceJa: ご見学ありがとうございました。それでは、日が決まりましたらご案内します。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-02-001-SHARED.translation: Thank you for visiting. We'll notify you once the date is decided. Have a safe journey home.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-03-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-03-001-SHARED.sourceJa: かごの品をまとめて確認なさいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-03-001-SHARED.translation: Would you like to check the items in your basket together?

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-03-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-03-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 今日は二千円までにしたいです。ご飯の材料と菓子を入れたら、予定を少し超えたので、選び直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-03-001-SHARED.hintJa: 二千円上限を超えた食材と菓子の買物を選び直したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-03-001-SHARED.translation: I'd like to spend no more than two thousand yen today. Adding meal ingredients and sweets took me a little over budget, so I'd like to choose again.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-03-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that your ingredients and sweets exceed your two-thousand-yen limit and you want to revise your choices.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-03-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-03-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 今の合計は二千三百円です。どの品を優先なさいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-03-001-SHARED.translation: The current total is two thousand three hundred yen. Which items are your priority?

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-03-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-03-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 米と卵、野菜は残したいです。菓子が四百円なので、それを外せば二千円以内にできますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-03-001-SHARED.hintJa: 米卵野菜を優先し四百円菓子を外す案を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-03-001-SHARED.translation: I'd like to keep the rice, eggs, and vegetables. The sweets cost four hundred yen, so removing them should keep me within two thousand, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-03-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Prioritize rice, eggs, and vegetables in Japanese and suggest removing the four-hundred-yen sweets.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-03-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-03-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 菓子を外すと千九百円になります。戻す品はこちらで受け取ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-03-001-SHARED.translation: Without the sweets, it's one thousand nine hundred yen. I'll take the item you're returning here.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-03-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-03-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 菓子をお願いします。ご飯の材料を減らして菓子を残すより、今日の食事を優先します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-03-001-SHARED.hintJa: 菓子を返し食材を減らすより当日の食事を優先すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-03-001-SHARED.translation: Please take the sweets. I'll prioritize today's meals over keeping sweets and reducing the ingredients.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-03-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Return the sweets in Japanese and prioritize today's meals rather than reducing ingredients.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-03-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-03-001-SHARED.sourceJa: お持ちの袋はありますか。袋を追加する場合は、料金も含めてご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-03-001-SHARED.translation: Do you have a bag? If you add one, please check the total including its charge too.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-03-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-03-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 袋を持っています。千九百円の品をその袋へ入れられるので、追加は要りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-03-001-SHARED.hintJa: 持参袋があり千九百円分を収め追加袋は不要と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-03-001-SHARED.translation: I have a bag. The nineteen-hundred-yen purchase will fit in it, so I don't need another.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-03-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that your own bag fits the nineteen-hundred-yen purchase and you don't need an extra bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-03-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-03-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 米、卵、野菜の三種類でお会計を進めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-03-001-SHARED.translation: I'll proceed with payment for the three kinds of items: rice, eggs, and vegetables.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-03-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-03-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 三種類でお願いします。二千円のうち百円を残せることも確認できました。次は菓子を入れる前に材料の合計を考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-03-001-SHARED.hintJa: 三種類購入と百円余りを確認し次は食材合計から考えると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-03-001-SHARED.translation: Those three, please. I've also confirmed that I'll have one hundred yen left from two thousand. Next time I'll total the ingredients before adding sweets.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-03-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Confirm the three kinds and hundred-yen remainder in Japanese and say you'll consider the ingredients' total first next time.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-03-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-03-001-SHARED.sourceJa: お会計はこちらです。それでは、お買物ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-03-001-SHARED.translation: Please pay here. Thank you for shopping with us.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-04-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-04-001-SHARED.sourceJa: ご注文は醤油ラーメン二杯で承りました。これからお作りします。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-04-001-SHARED.translation: We've taken your order for two soy-sauce ramen bowls. We'll start making them now.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-04-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-04-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 連れから十分ほど遅れると連絡がありました。私の分は今、連れの分は来てから作ってもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-04-001-SHARED.hintJa: 注文後の連れの十分遅着を知らせ二杯の調理開始を分けて頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-04-001-SHARED.translation: My companion just told me they'll be about ten minutes late. Could you make mine now and theirs after they arrive?
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-04-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Report your companion's ten-minute delay after ordering in Japanese and ask for separate cooking start times for the two bowls.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-04-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-04-001-SHARED.sourceJa: まだ麺をゆで始めていないので、そのようにできます。先にお出しする一杯は、どちらでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-04-001-SHARED.translation: We haven't started boiling the noodles yet, so we can do that. Which bowl should we serve first?

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-04-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-04-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 卵を付けた方が私の分です。連れの分は卵なしで、注文の内容は変えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-04-001-SHARED.hintJa: 本人卵付きと連れ卵なしを指定し注文内容の維持を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-04-001-SHARED.translation: The one with an egg is mine. My companion's is without an egg; the order itself hasn't changed.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-04-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Specify your egg-topped bowl and your companion's without egg in Japanese and keep the order unchanged.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-04-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-04-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 卵付きの一杯を先にお持ちします。お連れ様の到着時にお声がけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-04-001-SHARED.translation: We'll bring the egg-topped bowl first. Please let us know when your companion arrives.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-04-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-04-001-SHARED.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。連れには、そのまま店へ来て、到着してから温かい一杯を受け取れると伝えました。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-04-001-SHARED.hintJa: 到着後に温かい品を受け取れると連れへ共有済みと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-04-001-SHARED.translation: Thank you. I've told my companion to come straight here and that they'll get a hot bowl after arriving.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-04-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you've told your companion they'll receive a hot bowl after arriving.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-04-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-04-001-SHARED.sourceJa: こちらが卵付きです。もう一杯は、まだ調理を待っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-04-001-SHARED.translation: Here's the one with an egg. The other bowl is still waiting to be cooked.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-04-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-04-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 私の分を受け取りました。今、連れが入口に着きましたので、卵なしの一杯もお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-04-001-SHARED.hintJa: 本人の一杯を受領し連れ到着時に二杯目の調理を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-04-001-SHARED.translation: I've received mine. My companion has just reached the entrance, so please make the bowl without an egg too.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-04-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Acknowledge receiving your bowl in Japanese and request the second bowl's cooking when your companion arrives.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-04-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-04-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 二杯目をお作りします。お会計は、一緒でよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-04-001-SHARED.translation: We'll make the second bowl. Would you like to pay together?

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-04-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-04-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 一緒でお願いします。食べ始める時刻は別ですが、二杯分を私がまとめて払います。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-04-001-SHARED.hintJa: 異なる食事開始でも二杯分本人一括会計を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-04-001-SHARED.translation: Together, please. We'll start eating at different times, but I'll pay for both bowls together.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-04-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Request in Japanese to pay for both bowls yourself together despite starting to eat at different times.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-04-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-04-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、お連れ様にもご案内します。ごゆっくりお召し上がりください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-04-001-SHARED.translation: Certainly. I'll show your companion in too. Please enjoy your meal. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-05-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-05-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 今日はどのような案内をお探しでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-05-001-SHARED.translation: What sort of information are you looking for today?

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-05-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-05-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 引っ越した家に地域の清掃会の紙が届きました。参加したいのですが、住民の手続きと一緒に市役所へ申し込むのか分からず持って来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-05-001-SHARED.hintJa: 転入後の地域清掃通知を示し住民手続きと同じ申込先か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-05-001-SHARED.translation: A notice about neighborhood cleaning came to my new home. I'd like to join, but I brought it because I don't know whether to apply at city hall along with my resident procedures.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-05-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Show the neighborhood-cleaning notice after moving in Japanese and ask whether its application goes to the same place as resident procedures.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-05-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-05-001-SHARED.sourceJa: この紙では、町内会の担当が受付先になっています。連絡先の欄を一緒に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-05-001-SHARED.translation: This paper names the neighborhood association's organizer as the contact. Let's check the contact field together.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-05-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-05-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 下の欄ですね。今見つけられました。参加の返事は、こちらへ連絡するのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-05-001-SHARED.hintJa: 通知下部の町内会受付連絡先を見つけ返信先を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-05-001-SHARED.translation: The field at the bottom, right? I've found it now. So I should send my participation reply here?
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-05-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Find the neighborhood association contact at the notice's bottom in Japanese and confirm where to reply.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-05-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-05-001-SHARED.sourceJa: はい。集合場所と持ち物についても、この案内に記載があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-05-001-SHARED.translation: Yes. The meeting place and what to bring are also written in this notice.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-05-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-05-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 集合は朝九時で、軍手を持参と書いてあります。仕事の始まりより早いので、参加の予定を立てられそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-05-001-SHARED.hintJa: 朝九時集合と軍手持参を読み仕事前に参加予定が立つと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-05-001-SHARED.translation: It says to meet at nine in the morning and bring work gloves. That's before work starts, so I think I can plan to join.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-05-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Read the nine-a.m. meeting time and work-glove requirement in Japanese and say you can plan to join before work.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-05-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-05-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 参加できる時間などは、その担当へお伝えください。地域の活動を紹介する冊子もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-05-001-SHARED.translation: Please tell the organizer what times you can attend and so on. We also have a booklet introducing local activities.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-05-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-05-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 一冊いただきたいです。清掃会の後に続けて参加できる活動があるか、家で読んでみます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-05-001-SHARED.hintJa: 地域活動冊子一冊を希望し他活動も自宅で読むと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-05-001-SHARED.translation: I'd like one copy. I'll read it at home to see whether there are activities I can keep joining after the cleaning event.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-05-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Request one local-activities booklet in Japanese and say you'll read about other activities at home.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-05-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-05-001-SHARED.sourceJa: こちらをどうぞ。今回の返事をする時は、お名前と参加する人数もお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-05-001-SHARED.translation: Here you are. When replying about this event, please also give your name and the number attending.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-05-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-05-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 私は一人で参加すると伝えます。通知の担当連絡先、集合時刻、軍手の三つを控えられました。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-05-001-SHARED.hintJa: 本人一人参加を担当へ伝え連絡先時刻軍手を記録できたと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-05-001-SHARED.translation: I'll tell them I'll attend alone. I've noted the three points: organizer's contact, meeting time, and work gloves.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-05-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you'll tell the organizer you're attending alone and have noted the contact, time, and gloves.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-05-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-05-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 参加の準備ができましたね。それでは、地域の皆さんとの活動をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-05-001-SHARED.translation: You're ready to participate, then. Enjoy the activity with your neighbors.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-06-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-06-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 今日は、どんな展示にご興味がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-06-001-SHARED.translation: What kinds of exhibits interest you today?

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-06-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-06-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 昔の店で品物をどう運んでいたか知りたいです。道具が多く並んでいるので、運ぶ物から見始めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-06-001-SHARED.hintJa: 昔の店への品物運搬に関心があり運ぶ道具から展示を見たいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-06-001-SHARED.translation: I'd like to know how shops transported goods in the past. There are many tools displayed, so I'd like to start with the transporting ones.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-06-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese your interest in past deliveries to shops and wish to start with transport tools.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-06-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-06-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 運搬の道具は、この展示の手前にまとめています。背負う物と車で運ぶ物をご覧になれます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-06-001-SHARED.translation: The transport tools are grouped at the front of this exhibit. You can see equipment carried on the back and equipment for transporting goods by cart.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-06-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-06-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 手前から見ます。まず背負う道具を見て、その後で車の展示へ進みたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-06-001-SHARED.hintJa: 背負う道具を先に見て次に車展示へ進む順を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-06-001-SHARED.translation: I'll start at the front. I'd like to see the back-carrying tools first and then move on to the cart exhibit.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-06-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Choose in Japanese to view back-carrying tools first and carts next.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-06-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-06-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 背負う道具の説明には、持つ人と荷物の位置を図で示しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-06-001-SHARED.translation: The back-carrying tools' explanations have diagrams showing the positions of the carrier and load.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-06-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-06-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 図が分かりやすいです。店の中に並べる道具と、店へ届けるための道具が違うことを、ここで整理できそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-06-001-SHARED.hintJa: 人と荷物の図を受け店内陳列用と配送用道具を整理したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-06-001-SHARED.translation: The diagrams are easy to understand. I think I can clarify here how tools for displaying things inside shops differ from tools for delivering to them.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-06-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Use the carrier-and-load diagram in Japanese to say you want to distinguish shop-display tools from delivery tools.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-06-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-06-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 車の展示では、荷台の形に注目してみてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-06-001-SHARED.translation: At the cart exhibit, pay attention to the shape of the loading bed.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-06-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-06-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 背負う道具を見終えたら荷台の形を比べます。大きさだけでなく、品物を載せる場所を見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-06-001-SHARED.hintJa: 荷台は大きさだけでなく品物を載せる位置を比べたいと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-06-001-SHARED.translation: After the back-carrying tools, I'll compare the beds' shapes. I want to see not just their size but where goods are loaded.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-06-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want to compare loading positions as well as bed sizes.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-06-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-06-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 詳しく調べたい場合は、閲覧用の展示解説もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-06-001-SHARED.translation: If you'd like to investigate further, we have exhibit explanations available to read too.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-06-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-06-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 展示を見た後に閲覧用の解説を読みます。今日は運ぶ道具を中心に見て、生活のほかの道具は次に来た時の楽しみにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-06-001-SHARED.hintJa: 現物後に閲覧解説を読み今回は運搬中心で他生活道具は次回と決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-06-001-SHARED.translation: I'll read those explanations after seeing the exhibits. I'll focus on transport tools today and save the other everyday tools for my next visit.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-06-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Decide in Japanese to read the reference explanation after viewing the objects, focus on transport today, and leave other daily tools for next time.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-06-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-06-001-SHARED.sourceJa: では、手前の展示からどうぞ。それでは、商いの道具をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-06-001-SHARED.translation: Please start with the front display, then. Enjoy the tools of trade.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-07-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-07-001-SHARED.sourceJa: お薬の説明を始めてもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-07-001-SHARED.translation: May I start explaining your medicine?

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-07-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-07-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 仕事の電話がまだ続いていて、今のままだと説明を聞き逃しそうです。電話を終えてから、落ち着いて聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-07-001-SHARED.hintJa: 仕事通話中で薬説明を逃しそうなため終了後に集中して聞きたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-07-001-SHARED.translation: I'm still on a work call, and I might miss the explanation like this. I'd like to finish the call and listen calmly.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-07-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you're on a work call and may miss the medicine explanation, so you want to listen attentively after finishing it.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-07-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-07-001-SHARED.sourceJa: お電話を終える間、お待ちできます。周囲に配慮して、受付で通話の場所をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-07-001-SHARED.translation: We can wait while you finish. Please ask reception where to talk, out of consideration for people around you.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-07-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-07-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 場所を聞いて短く終えます。職場には薬の説明を受けてから戻ると伝え、仕事の相談をいったん区切ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-07-001-SHARED.hintJa: 受付で場所を聞き職場へ説明後に戻ると知らせ短く通話を区切る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-07-001-SHARED.translation: I'll ask where and finish quickly. I'll tell work I'm coming back after the medicine explanation and pause the work discussion for now.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-07-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you'll ask reception where to call, tell work you'll return after the explanation, and end the call shortly.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-07-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-07-001-SHARED.sourceJa: お戻りになりましたら、この席へお声をかけてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-07-001-SHARED.translation: When you return, please let us know at this seat.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-07-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-07-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 戻りました。電話は終わり、携帯は鞄へしまいました。最初から説明をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-07-001-SHARED.hintJa: 戻り通話終了と携帯収納を伝え最初から説明を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-07-001-SHARED.translation: I'm back. The call is over, and I've put my phone in my bag. Please explain from the beginning.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-07-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you're back, the call has ended, and your phone is put away, then request the explanation from the start.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-07-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-07-001-SHARED.sourceJa: では、お渡しする資料を一緒に見ましょう。気になる点は途中でお聞きください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-07-001-SHARED.translation: Let's look at the materials we're giving you together. Please ask about any concerns as we go.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-07-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-07-001-SHARED.sourceJa: この注意の欄が気になります。聞くだけで覚えようとせず、資料のどこを見るかも教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-07-001-SHARED.hintJa: 注意欄について口頭記憶だけでなく資料で確認する場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-07-001-SHARED.translation: I'm concerned about this precautions section. Rather than trying to remember everything I hear, please show me where to check in the materials too.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-07-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese where to check the precautions in writing rather than relying only on memory of the spoken explanation.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-07-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-07-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 注意はこの欄、問い合わせ先はこちらです。内容を順にご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-07-001-SHARED.translation: The precautions are in this field, and the contact information is here. I'll explain the contents in order.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-07-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-07-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 欄と問い合わせ先を見つけました。分からない言葉が出たらその場で聞き、説明が済むまで別の仕事の電話は受けないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-07-001-SHARED.hintJa: 注意欄と問合先を見つけ不明語はその場で質問し説明中は別仕事電話を避ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-07-001-SHARED.translation: I've found the field and contact details. I'll ask right away about unfamiliar words and avoid taking other work calls until the explanation is finished.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-07-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you've found the precautions and contact details, will ask about unclear words immediately, and avoid other work calls during the explanation.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-07-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-07-001-SHARED.sourceJa: ここから詳しい説明の担当へつなぎますので、資料を手元に置いてお待ちください。それでは、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-07-001-SHARED.translation: I'll connect you to the person giving the detailed explanation now. Please wait with the materials at hand. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-08-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-08-001-SHARED.sourceJa: はがきの交換についてのお尋ねでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-08-001-SHARED.translation: Are you asking about exchanging postcards?

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-08-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-08-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 宛名を書き間違えた二枚を持ってきました。どちらも出していません。新しい通常はがきに交換できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-08-001-SHARED.hintJa: 未投函の宛名書き損じ二枚を通常はがきへ交換できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-08-001-SHARED.translation: I brought two with incorrectly written addresses. I haven't posted either. Can I exchange them for new standard postcards?
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-08-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether two unposted postcards with address-writing errors can be exchanged for standard postcards.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-08-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-08-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 現物を確認します。料金を表す部分は、そのまま残っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-08-001-SHARED.translation: I'll check the actual cards. Is the part showing postage still intact?

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-08-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-08-001-SHARED.sourceJa: はい。この二枚です。間違えたのは宛名で、料金の表示には書いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-08-001-SHARED.hintJa: 現物二枚を示し料金表示は書損じていないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-08-001-SHARED.translation: Yes, these are the two. The mistakes are in the addresses; I haven't written on the postage markings.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-08-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Show the two postcards in Japanese and explain that the postage markings weren't spoiled.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-08-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-08-001-SHARED.sourceJa: この二枚は交換できます。交換の費用はこちらです。新しいはがきも二枚でよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-08-001-SHARED.translation: These two can be exchanged. Here's the exchange charge. Would you like two new postcards as well?

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-08-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-08-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 二枚お願いします。費用の合計を確認しましたので、現金で払います。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-08-001-SHARED.hintJa: 交換可能の案内と費用を確認し新しい二枚を指定して払う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-08-001-SHARED.translation: Two, please. I've checked the total charge and will pay cash.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-08-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Confirm the exchange and charge in Japanese, specify two new postcards, and pay.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-08-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-08-001-SHARED.sourceJa: お支払いを確認しました。こちらが交換した二枚です。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-08-001-SHARED.translation: I've confirmed your payment. Here are your two replacement postcards.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-08-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-08-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 二枚とも文字のない物を受け取りました。今回は通常はがきを使い、宛名は別の紙で下書きしてから書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-08-001-SHARED.hintJa: 新しい無記入二枚を照合し宛名は別紙下書き後に書くと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-08-001-SHARED.translation: I've received two blank cards. I'll use standard postcards this time and draft the addresses on separate paper before writing them.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-08-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Check the two new blank postcards in Japanese and say you'll draft addresses on separate paper first.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-08-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-08-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 交換のお会計の控えもお渡しします。今日、この二枚を差し出されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-08-001-SHARED.translation: Here's your exchange payment receipt too. Will you post these two today?

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-08-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-08-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 今日は交換だけです。家で書いてから出しますので、新しい二枚と控えを持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-08-001-SHARED.hintJa: 当日は交換のみで新はがき二枚と控えを持帰ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-08-001-SHARED.translation: Today is just the exchange. I'll write them at home before posting, so I'll take the two new cards and receipt home.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-08-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that today's visit is only for exchange and you'll take the two new cards and receipt home.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-08-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-08-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 交換を承りました。それでは、お忘れ物のないようお持ちください。ご利用ありがとうございました。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-FUKUCHIYAMA-08-001-SHARED.translation: Your exchange is complete. Please take everything with you. Thank you for using our service. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-KYT-KAMEOKA-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KYT-KAMEOKA-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 船内でのご希望はございますか。
DLG-SC-KYT-KAMEOKA-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have any preferences for your time aboard?

DLG-SC-KYT-KAMEOKA-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KYT-KAMEOKA-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人と同じ角度から写真を撮りたいです。途中で席を交換できると思っていましたが、乗る前に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-KYT-KAMEOKA-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同行者と同角度の撮影に途中席交換できるか事前に聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KYT-KAMEOKA-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to take photos from the same angle as my friend. I thought we could swap seats along the way, but I'd like to check before boarding.
DLG-SC-KYT-KAMEOKA-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese before boarding whether you can swap seats along the way to photograph from the same angle as your companion.

DLG-SC-KYT-KAMEOKA-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KYT-KAMEOKA-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご案内する席でお過ごしください。移動の扱いは、その時の係の案内に従っていただきます。
DLG-SC-KYT-KAMEOKA-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please stay in the seats we assign. For movement, follow the staff's instructions at the time.

DLG-SC-KYT-KAMEOKA-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KYT-KAMEOKA-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 同じ角度にそろえることを優先して席を替える予定はやめます。それぞれの席から見える景色を撮ります。
DLG-SC-KYT-KAMEOKA-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 撮影角度統一を優先する席交換計画をやめ各自席から撮ると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KYT-KAMEOKA-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'll drop the plan to swap seats just to match our angles. We'll photograph the scenery visible from our own seats.
DLG-SC-KYT-KAMEOKA-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you'll abandon swapping seats for matching photo angles and take photos from your assigned seats.

DLG-SC-KYT-KAMEOKA-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KYT-KAMEOKA-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 違う角度の写真を、後で見比べる楽しみもありますね。
DLG-SC-KYT-KAMEOKA-001-SHARED-05.translation: Comparing photos from different angles afterward can be enjoyable too.

DLG-SC-KYT-KAMEOKA-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KYT-KAMEOKA-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: そうですね。私は近い岸を、友人は反対側の景色を撮って、帰ってから二人で見たいです。
DLG-SC-KYT-KAMEOKA-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 近い岸と反対側を各自撮り帰宅後比較する案を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KYT-KAMEOKA-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I'd like to photograph the nearer bank while my friend photographs the opposite side, then look at them together when we get home.
DLG-SC-KYT-KAMEOKA-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose in Japanese to photograph the near bank and opposite view separately and compare at home.

DLG-SC-KYT-KAMEOKA-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KYT-KAMEOKA-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 撮影する時も、顔を上げて案内や周囲の様子をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-KYT-KAMEOKA-001-SHARED-07.translation: Even while taking photos, please look up to check the guidance and what's happening around you.

DLG-SC-KYT-KAMEOKA-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KYT-KAMEOKA-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 画面だけを見続けず、案内も聞きます。写真を撮るためだけに全行程を過ごさず、しばらくは景色を直接見ます。
DLG-SC-KYT-KAMEOKA-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 画面だけでなく案内と景色を直接見る時間も取ると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KYT-KAMEOKA-001-SHARED-08.translation: I won't keep looking only at the screen; I'll listen to the guidance too. I won't spend the whole journey only taking photos, and I'll look directly at the scenery for a while.
DLG-SC-KYT-KAMEOKA-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you'll attend to guidance and spend time viewing scenery directly instead of only watching your screen.

DLG-SC-KYT-KAMEOKA-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KYT-KAMEOKA-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お乗りになる前に、携帯をしまう場所も整えておいてください。
DLG-SC-KYT-KAMEOKA-001-SHARED-09.translation: Before boarding, please also prepare somewhere to put your phone away.

DLG-SC-KYT-KAMEOKA-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KYT-KAMEOKA-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 上着のポケットに入れられます。友人には、同じ写真を一枚ずつ撮るより、違う景色を見て後で共有しようと伝えました。
DLG-SC-KYT-KAMEOKA-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 携帯収納ポケットを示し違う景色を後で共有する予定を友人へ伝えたと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KYT-KAMEOKA-001-SHARED-10.translation: It fits in my jacket pocket. I've told my friend we should see different scenery and share it later rather than each take the same photo.
DLG-SC-KYT-KAMEOKA-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Indicate your phone-storage pocket in Japanese and say you've told your friend about sharing different views afterward.

DLG-SC-KYT-KAMEOKA-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KYT-KAMEOKA-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、ご案内する席へどうぞ。船からの眺めをお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-KYT-KAMEOKA-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please go to your assigned seats, then. Enjoy the view from the boat.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今日はこの台で、収穫した野菜を袋へ入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Today we'll put harvested vegetables into bags at this table.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この高さだとずっと腰を曲げる形になります。長く作業する前に、立ちやすい台を使えるか相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 低い台で腰を曲げ続けるため作業前に適した高さを相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: At this height, I'd be bending at the waist the whole time. Before working for long, I'd like to ask about using a table I can stand at more comfortably.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Discuss a suitable table height in Japanese before working, because the low table makes you keep bending.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 高さの違う台が隣にあります。袋と野菜を置いた時の届き方を見てみましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: There's a table of a different height next to it. Let's see how you can reach with bags and vegetables on it.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 隣の台なら手を伸ばしすぎず届きます。今の台の下へ箱を重ねるより、その台へ移ってよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 隣台なら届きやすく自己積み箱よりその台へ移りたいと尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I can reach the next table without stretching too far. May I move there rather than stack boxes under this table myself?
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that the neighboring table is easier to reach and ask to move there rather than stack boxes yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。こちらで使う分を隣へ用意します。袋を置く場所はどちらが使いやすいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. We'll prepare what you need there. Which side would be easiest for the bags?

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 右側が使いやすいです。野菜を左、袋を右に置けば、同じ場所を何度も往復せずに進められます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 野菜左袋右の配置で手の往復を減らしたいと具体的に提案する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: The right side is easier. With vegetables on the left and bags on the right, I can work without moving back and forth over the same area repeatedly.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Propose vegetables on the left and bags on the right in Japanese to reduce repeated hand movements.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その配置で少し試してください。通路に物が出ないようにお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Try that arrangement for a little while. Please keep things out of the passage.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 一袋できました。台の上で全部収まり、通路には出ていません。完成した袋は奥のかごへ入れたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 一袋試作し通路にはみ出さず完成袋の奥かご希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've finished one bag. Everything fits on the table and nothing protrudes into the passage. I'd like to put finished bags in the basket at the back.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report one trial bag in Japanese, confirm nothing obstructs the passage, and ask to use the rear basket for finished bags.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 完成品用のかごを奥へ用意しました。作業の途中でも負担があればお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: I've put a finished-product basket at the back. Please tell us if you feel strain during work too.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この配置で続けます。休憩の時に届き方も振り返り、負担が出たらその時点で相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 試した配置で続け休憩で負担を振返り発生時に相談すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll continue with this arrangement. I'll review how things are within reach during my break and consult you as soon as I feel strain.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you'll continue with the tested layout, review strain at your break, and consult when it occurs.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、隣の台でお願いします。それでは、最初の一組が終わったらまた伺います。お疲れさまです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please work at the neighboring table, then. I'll check in again after the first set is finished. Thank you for your work.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 白菜をお探しですか。丸ごとと半分の物がございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for Chinese cabbage? We have whole heads and halves.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 一人暮らしなので半分がほしいです。包みの下に切り口があって見えないので、店の方に向きを変えて見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 一人用半白菜を希望し隠れた切口を店員が向き変更して示すよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I live alone, so I'd like a half. The cut face is hidden under the wrapping. Could a staff member turn it so I can see?
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Request half a cabbage for one person in Japanese and ask staff to turn it to show the hidden cut face.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらでお見せします。今並んでいる中では、大きめと小さめがあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll show you. We currently have larger and smaller ones on display.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 小さめを見たいです。今日の鍋に使うので、丸ごと一株を買う予定ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 今日の鍋用で小さい半分を希望し一株購入ではないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'd like to see a smaller one. It's for tonight's hot pot, so I don't plan to buy a whole head.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want a small half for tonight's hot pot, not a whole head.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらが小さめの半分です。向きを変えると、切り口もご覧になれます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Here's a smaller half. Turning it lets you see the cut face too.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 見えました。この一つにします。包みを自分で外す必要がなくて助かりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 切口が見え小さめ一つの購入を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I can see it. I'll take this one. It's helpful not to have to remove the wrapping myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you can see the cut face and decide to buy one smaller half.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ほかに鍋に入れる野菜は、必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you need any other vegetables for your hot pot?

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: きのこを一袋追加したいです。白菜が小さめでも、ほかの具があるので大きい物へ替えなくて大丈夫です。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: きのこ一袋を追加し他具もあるので白菜を大きく変更しないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'd like one bag of mushrooms too. Even with a smaller cabbage, I have other ingredients, so there's no need to switch to a larger one.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Add one bag of mushrooms in Japanese and say you won't change to a larger cabbage because you have other ingredients.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: きのこはこちらです。白菜一つと、きのこ一袋でよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: The mushrooms are here. One cabbage portion and one bag of mushrooms, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: その二点でお願いします。今夜使う分を選べたので、持っている袋へ二点を一緒に入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 白菜一つきのこ一袋を確定し持参袋へ二点入れると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Those two, please. I've chosen what I need tonight, so I'll put both together in the bag I brought.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm one cabbage portion and one mushroom bag in Japanese and say you'll put both in your own bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございました。それでは、温かいお鍋をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. Enjoy your warm hot pot.
